13:1.text: These are the verses of the Book; and what has been revealed to you from your Lord is the truth, but most of the people do not believe.

13:2.text: It is Allāh who erected the heavens without pillars that you
see; then He established Himself above the Throne
the sun and the moon, each running
for a specified term. He arranges
matter; He details the signs that you may, of the meeting with your Lord, be certain.

13:3.text: And it is He who spread the earth and placed therein firmly set mountains and rivers; and from all of the fruits He made therein two mates; He causes the night to cover the day. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.

13:4.text: And within the land are neighboring plots and gardens of grapevines and crops and palm trees,
several from a root or otherwise,
watered with one water; but We make some of them exceed others in
fruit. Indeed in that are signs for a people who reason.

13:5.text: - then astonishing is their saying, "When we are dust, will we indeed be
into a new creation?" Those are the ones who have disbelieved in their Lord, and those will have shackles
upon their necks, and those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally.
